text:
maria: quick check — we need to align three PRs that touch SDK, console, and helm runtime values. SDK PR #462 is blocked on the API header rename. can we sequence merges so console + helm don't break prod?
kevin: I approved the API PR (#431) but left one comment about the header fallback. if we keep both headers for 2 weeks it should be safe.
yasmin: console here — can you paste the exact header name change? my PR #77 uses the old header in a couple places.
maria: header rename: `X-Client-Id` -> `X-Rdw-Client-Id` (we add fallback to `X-Client-Id` for 2w). example check in api: `const clientId = req.get('X-Rdw-Client-Id') || req.get('X-Client-Id');`
samir: runtime/helm note — we also need to bump the kv-cache image tag in values.yaml to 1.9.0 for the new scheduling behavior. helm PR #88 is ready but will momentarily fail e2e if console changes the header earlier.
kevin: suggestion: merge API (#431) with the fallback, then merge SDK (#462) pinned to fallback-compatible SDK, then console (#77) and finally helm (#88). we can do a canary for console in staging for 24h.
maria: timeline sounds good. who can do the staging canary? @olivia?
olivia: I can run the staging canary today at 15:00 PT. will monitor latency and token error rates. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: CI: API #431 — checks passed. SDK #462 — failing build (integration-test timeout). Console #77 — lint ok, unit tests ok. Helm #88 — chart lint OK.
kevin: SDK failing integration test is unrelated, I have a fix in a branch. will open quick PR and tag this thread.
yasmin: console change is small; I'll add a compatibility flag in config to toggle old header for 2w. PR update incoming.
maria: action items: (1) kevin ping when SDK fix is up, (2) kevin/kevin? run canary deploy for API w/ fallback, (3) yasmin update console config flag, (4) samir hold helm merge until console canary green.
kevin: on it — targeting SDK patch in next 30m. will comment here when merged.
samir: noted, I'll hold helm merge and coordinate with release-bot for rollout window.
release-bot: scheduling note — next cross-repo rollout window available: 2026-03-18 17:00 UTC -> 18:00 UTC. reply "confirm" to reserve.
maria: reserving that window now. please confirm CI green before merging in that hour.
kevin: SDK patch merged — CI passing for SDK (#462.1). tagging @yasmin and @samir.
yasmin: console patch pushed with config flag, running staging deploy now.
olivia: staging canary started. will report back in ~30m.
ci-bot: Staging deploy: console #77 — integration tests passed. monitoring metrics stream: https://internal.metrics/redwood/staging/console-canary
olivia: quick update — canary looks clean so far, no header errors, latency steady. will run full 24h but feel ok to proceed to helm hold. :rocket:
maria: great — proceed per plan. thanks everyone.
kevin: merging API + SDK now. leaving helm to samir after final checks.
samir: will merge helm in rollout window. tagging ops to watch.
release-bot: rollout window reserved for maria.
